name: bell
description: A gently squared bell with a separate hanging clapper.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The integrated top hanger is shortened by 0.5 unit (from 2.3 to 1.8 units above its shoulder junction) so it reads as a compact nub. The full drawing is then translated upward by 0.25 unit to keep opposite vertical margins balanced: centerline bounds y=2.75..21.25, visible Regular bounds y=1.9..22.1. Straight walls, shoulders, lower lip and clapper proportions are retained. No doubled seams. Owner-approved source; Outline geometry retained through the Filled clapper correction. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved Bell after the solid Filled clapper correction. Both styles reviewed at source proportions and Regular 1.70; the Filled clapper is a solid part with no U-shaped recess.
